attacks.name: Automatic Pistols
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!hit| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make one additional Automatic Pistol attack. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the Rapid Fire special rule.

attacks.name: Grenade Bounce
steps: This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.
|*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.
|!wild| |*Explosive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

attacks.name: Lucky Shot
steps: The defender does not gain |!power| for |!damage| dealt by this attack.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

superPowers.name: Probability Manipulation
superPowers.body: After this character rolls attack, defense, or dodge dice but before the |*Resolve Criticals| step, it may spend any amount of |!power| to use this superpower. For each 1 |!power| spent, choose 1 |!failure| to treat as a |!critical| for the remainder of that attack or collision.

superPowers.name: Things Tend To Go My Way
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking or defending, enemy characters do not roll additional dice for |!critical| results in their attack or defense rolls.
